section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion states that the present (single) study examined relationships between body appreciation in men and conformity to masculine norms, upward appearance-based social comparisons, and frequency of physical activity, and tested differences by sexual orientation and potential mediators. The authors highlight that findings can inform interventions to enhance positive body image among men, noting such interventions are rare and often ineffective.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The present study is valuable because it is the first to investigate the relationships between body appreciation in men and conformity to masculine norms, upward appearance-based social comparisons, and frequency of physical activity." "This study is also the first to test whether body appreciation differs between sexual minority and heterosexual men, and to investigate the potential mediators of this relationship."
